articles.title: Spider-Man's Biggest Problem? No One Remembers Him!
articles.summary: Peter Parker is back, but thanks to a magic spell, even his best friends don't know who he is. The new trailer shows him fighting Scorpion, ninjas, and the Hulk—all while trying to stop a mysterious villain only he can sense. The movie swings into theaters July 31, 2026.

articles.title: A Giant Milky-Green Swirl Appeared in a Lake—From Space!
articles.summary: Astronauts on the International Space Station spotted a huge, milky-green vortex in Lake Skadar, Europe's largest lake. It's not algae—it's actually tiny bits of rock from melting snow. The lake is so deep, most of its bottom is below sea level!

articles.title: This Flip Phone Is Dumb in the Best Way—and It's Only $299!
articles.summary: The Light Flip is a new phone that can't use social media or apps. It looks like a cool old-school flip phone, comes in six fun colors, and costs $299. It's made for people who want a break from smartphones. Ships in April 2027.
